wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.depositsUnavailable: Deposits are temporarily unavailable. Please check back shortly.
wallet.depositNoteLinked: Send only USDC on Ethereum (ERC20). Tokens on the wrong network or contract will be lost. Deposits from your linked wallets are credited automatically after the required confirmations.
wallet.depositNoteUnlinked: Link your sending wallet below before depositing. Deposits from unlinked addresses require manual review and may be delayed.
wallet.withdrawNote: USDC on Ethereum (ERC20). Manual review by an admin before payout.
wallet.withdrawReviewNote: Withdrawals are reviewed manually. The amount is locked while pending and refunded if rejected. Cancel an unreviewed request below.
wallet.errInvalidDestination: Destination is not a valid ERC20 address.
wallet.errInternalDestination: That address belongs to Oddzilla — pick an external one.
wallet.errAmountZero: Amount must be greater than zero.
wallet.linkedWalletsIntro: Register the ERC20 address you send USDC from. You'll sign a one-time message with that wallet to prove you control it; then deposits arriving from it are auto-credited after confirmations — no tx hash to paste. One address can only be linked to one Oddzilla account.
wallet.linkSuccess: Wallet verified and linked. Future deposits from it will credit automatically.
wallet.noWalletDetected: No Ethereum wallet detected. Install MetaMask (or another browser wallet) to link a sending address.
wallet.addressFormat: Address must be 0x followed by 40 hex characters.
wallet.accountMismatch: Your wallet's active account doesn't match this address. Switch to it in your wallet, or use Connect wallet to fill it in.
wallet.errAlreadyLinked: That address is already linked (possibly to another account).
wallet.errInternalAddress: That's the Oddzilla receive address — pick a sending wallet you control.
wallet.errCustodialAddress: That looks like an exchange/custodial address, which can't be linked. Use a self-custodial wallet you control.
wallet.errSignatureMismatch: The signature didn't match this address. Sign with the wallet that owns it.
wallet.errInvalidSignature: Could not verify the signature. Please try signing again.
wallet.errChallengeExpired: The signing request expired. Please try again.
wallet.errInvalidAddress: That doesn't look like a valid ERC20 address.
wallet.errSignatureRejected: Signature request was rejected in your wallet.

cookieConsent.title: Cookies on Oddzilla
cookieConsent.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in, secure your account, and remember your preferences. We also load embedded third-party content (live streams and statistics widgets) that can set its own cookies, and collect first-party analytics about how the site is used.
cookieConsent.catNecessaryBody: Sign-in, security, and preference cookies. Always on.
cookieConsent.catEmbedsBody: Live streams from Twitch, YouTube, Kick and Gjirafa, plus statistics and match-tracker widgets served by third-party data providers. These providers may set their own cookies.
cookieConsent.catAnalyticsBody: First-party usage statistics (pages visited, clicks, session length) processed only on our own servers. Never shared with third parties.
cookieConsent.embedsBlockedBody: Embedded streams and widgets stay off until you accept cookies. Accepting lets the provider set its own cookies.
